transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I came in because... it's my husband's sister. She’s been working this family business so she can get control of the money and push me out of all the decisions. She’s always been sneaky like that. I remember back when she bought that little white car, a Pontiac I think it was, and she’d park it right on our grass. You can't park on the grass, it kills the roots. My neighbor tried to reseed his lawn last spring and the birds just ate every single seed. Just a whole flock of them swooping down, ate the whole yard bare. 

But anyway, with his sister, no matter how folks try to smooth it over, I know what I’ve been seeing for more than a year now. They think I don't notice what she's doing with the accounts, but I do. Just like I noticed the price of eggs going up again at the grocery store. It's ridiculous, honestly, almost four dollars for a dozen. How is anyone supposed to bake at those prices?
Do you believe your husband's sister is intentionally trying to harm or undermine you in any way?

Oh, absolutely she is. She's doing it on purpose, trying to undermine me and push me right out of all the family decisions. I've been watching her work this family business for over a year now, trying to get control of all the money. And you know, people try to smooth it over, tell me I'm just imagining things, but I know what I've been seeing. Just like I know what I saw at the post office the other day. The clerk there, he was stamping the letters so hard, just bang, bang, bang. I thought he was going to break the desk. It's a nice desk, too, solid oak, I think. My uncle had an oak table in his dining room. We used to have Thanksgiving there, and he'd always carve the turkey with this electric knife that made the loudest buzzing sound. It used to scare the dog so bad he'd hide under the sofa until dessert. But yes, she's definitely trying to harm me, trying to take everything over. I'm not blind to it, no matter what anyone says.
Do you feel that people are plotting against you or working together to harm you in some way?

Well, like I was just telling you a minute ago, it's really his sister doing the plotting. I don't know if a whole group of people are working together, but she's definitely the one working this family business angle to get her hands on the money and push me out of every single decision. I've been watching her do it for over a year now. And the rest of the family, they just try to smooth it over, you know? They act like nothing's wrong. 

Smoothing it over... it's just like when I try to iron my husband's shirts. He insists on heavy starch, but you can't even buy the good spray starch at the local market anymore. I had to drive all the way out to the big supercenter on Route 9 just to find it. And the traffic out there? Just terrible. They had the left lane closed for pothole repairs. I don't understand why they always do road work in the middle of the day when everyone is trying to run their errands. My cousin Jimmy used to drive a steamroller for the county, and he always worked the night shift. He said the fresh asphalt smells so much worse when the hot sun beats down on it. He actually had to quit that job eventually because the fumes made his allergies act up so bad, his eyes would just water all day long. 

But anyway, they can try to smooth it over all they want, but I know exactly what she's trying to do with our money.
Do you often feel that others are deceiving you or taking advantage of you in everyday situations, even when there's no clear evidence that this is happening?

No, no, I don't really feel like that with everyday folks. It's just her. I don't think regular people are trying to trick me or take advantage. If I go down to the pharmacy or the grocery store, people are perfectly nice. Well, except maybe that one time the cashier gave me the wrong change, but she was just a teenager and it was an honest mistake. Teenagers these days, they're always on those phones anyway. I saw a girl walking right into a light pole downtown because she was staring at her screen. Dropped her ice cream cone right on the sidewalk. It was mint chocolate chip, too, which is a real shame because that's the best flavor. My husband always gets vanilla, but I tell him vanilla is just boring. We went to the dairy bar on Route 4 last weekend and he got a plain vanilla cone. The line was so long, wrapped all the way around the building. They have this giant plastic cow on the roof, and they paint it for different holidays. For Halloween, they put a giant witch hat on it, and for Christmas they wrap it in lights. I think the bulbs were half burnt out last year, though. 

But anyway, no, I don't think strangers or anyone else is plotting or deceiving me. It's just my husband's sister with the family money.
Have you ever felt that certain people, organizations, or forces are controlling your thoughts or actions, or that you’re receiving special messages that others don’t understand?

No, nothing like that. I don't feel like anyone's controlling my thoughts or sending me secret messages or anything. My thoughts are my own. I just know what I see with his sister. 

Thoughts being controlled... you know, that sounds like one of those science fiction movies my nephew likes to watch. He came over last month and made us watch this whole marathon of movies about aliens taking over people's brains. He brought over this huge bowl of popcorn, but he put way too much butter on it. I mean, it was practically swimming in it. I told him he's going to ruin his cholesterol if he keeps eating like that. My doctor told me I need to watch my cholesterol, actually. He told me to eat more oatmeal. I tried that steel-cut kind, but it takes forever to cook on the stove. You have to stand there and stir it for like twenty minutes or it sticks to the bottom of the pan. And scrubbing a burnt pot is just the worst. I use those little copper wire pads, but they always rust if you leave them on the edge of the sink. I bought this little ceramic dish just to hold the sponge, it has little painted daisies on it. I found it at a yard sale down the street. The lady selling it had the most beautiful garden, just full of hydrangeas. 

But no, no one is controlling my thoughts or sending me messages. It's just the situation with the family money and her trying to push me out.
Have you ever felt that you have special powers, abilities, or importance that others do not recognize?

No, I don't have any special powers or anything. I'm just a regular person trying to make sure my family doesn't get taken to the cleaners by my sister-in-law. 

Special powers... wouldn't that be something, though? If I had special powers, maybe I could just snap my fingers and make the house clean itself. I spent three hours yesterday just trying to get the hard water stains off the shower doors. We have well water, you see, and it leaves this awful white crust on everything. My husband was supposed to put salt in the water softener last week, but of course he forgot. He forgets everything lately. I sent him to the store for milk and he came back with a bag of lemons and no milk. What am I supposed to do with a whole bag of lemons? I ended up making a lemon meringue pie, but the meringue fell flat because it was too humid out. My grandmother always used to say you can't bake a good meringue when it's raining, and she was right. She used to bake the most wonderful pies for the church bake sale. Every year, she'd make a cherry pie with this beautiful lattice crust. I tried to do a lattice crust once, but the dough kept breaking apart. You have to keep the butter really cold, I think. That's the secret. 

But anyway, no, I'm not important like that, no special abilities or anything. Just trying to protect what's ours.
